[RTIM.7.1.1] The reference runtime ships a conformance-suite runner that runs
the conformance catalogue against the engine and reports pass or fail per test.
The runner is a harness on this document's terms: an ordinary engine, the mock
clock, the driving operations and the stream ([RTIM.2.1]). The catalogue, its
fixture shapes and how the runner evaluates them are RCTS; the category
contract the catalogue satisfies is LCON.
